sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Serge Ferrari Group designs, develops, and manufactures innovative composite membranes and technical solutions for sustainable construction, equipment, and building design applications.

Industry: Materials · HQ: Évreux, France · Size: <$50M · Products: Batyline, Soltis, Tenseo, Stamisol, Defender, Aqua membranes

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Serge Ferrari Group scores 31 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 100% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (12/30) and pain-point alignment (15/15). Nothing was found for application fit and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, weatherability, cleanability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar surfaces clean up with mild detergent, no abrasives, no gloss loss. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (15% similar on protection, color, performance, signage); Mactac (7% similar on signage, protection, chemical, chill). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
